title: 第5章 灵符师第6章 两个跳梁小丑
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
离开了讲功堂，沈卿若好奇的问道：“沈云哥哥准备去哪？”
沈云掂量了一下乾坤袋，随口道：“去一趟坊市，你呢？”
如今灵石在手，沈云准备学一门修仙灵艺。
沈卿若微笑着说道：“正好现在没事，不如我陪你一起去吧！”
听闻此言，沈云心中古怪，一分钟前她才拒绝了沈秋，没想到变卦比翻书还快。
‘说起来除了刚认识的时候，卿若从来没给我摆过脸色。
沈云心头感叹，这一世除了沈父，相处最久就是眼前的沈卿若，不知不觉已将她看做自己的亲人了。
沈卿若眨了眨眼睛，悄然跟在他的身后，心中暗暗道：‘沈云哥哥最近神神秘秘的，我倒要看看他在做什么。
沈家位于沧浪山东部，族地幅员辽阔。
群山峻岭中，有一片巨大的开阔平地，其上有一座巍峨大气的城市坐落。
车水马龙，人流如梭，城门处聚集了许多来往商队，正在排队等待进城。
“不愧是沈家坊市，来往行客络绎不绝。”
“有沈家的庇护，没有劫修敢轻易来犯，消费高一些也是值得的。”
“听说坊市里无所不有，我已经等不及要进城了。”
“…”
沈云刚一进城，顿觉眼前一阔。
宽广的青石板路延伸到地平线，街道两旁商铺林立，品类齐全。
灵食店、灵符铺、丹药坊…看的人眼花缭乱，走过金碧辉煌的七层灵阁，两位花枝招展的女修正在揽客。
沈卿若柳眉一皱，面无表情得拉着沈云快速离开。
见到他俩的样子，女修捂嘴微笑道：“年轻真好。”

沈卿若只顾着埋头向前，沈云有些无奈道：“停下吧，灵符楼已经走过了。”
闻言沈卿若才停下了脚步，回首轻哼道：“爹爹以前就喜欢去仙乐坊，被娘亲教训了好多次，沈云哥哥可不能学他。”
沈云嘴角一抽，‘安叔长得浓眉大眼，没想到竟喜欢勾栏听曲。
感叹片刻后沈云连忙翻过这一篇，随后走向灵符楼。
刚进大门，就见到数十个水晶柜台，其中摆满了各种品类的灵符，琳琅满目。
老掌柜坐在柜台前，盘串喝茶两不误，老神在在的样子，也不管顾客买不买，主打一个佛系。
等沈云准备挑选东西时，一个瘦小的店员迎面而来，招呼道：“客人需要买点什么？”
待看清来者，沈云有些迟疑道：“你是沈钟吗？”
店员定睛一看，欢喜道：“原来是云兄弟，今天怎么来灵符楼了？”
沈云微微一笑，“我对灵符师很感兴趣，准备来买点材料。”
他和沈钟做过两年邻居，之后对方家境中落，搬到了山下居住，没想到竟在这里遇到了。
“沈钟哥是在这里当学徒吗？”
沈卿若也认识沈钟，于是出言询问。
沈钟点了点头，感慨道：“我在这里当了两年半的学徒，沈云兄弟若是想成为灵符师，可算问对人了。”
只见他双手如飞，从柜台中拿出玉简、符纸、符笔、符墨，而后介绍道：“这些就是制符需要的工具了。”
沈云接过了材料，毫不迟疑道：“一共多少灵石？”
他之前了解过行情，法符的利润虽然不如炼丹和炼器，但好在销量大、制作快，并且入门成本低，是挣灵石最好的选择。
沈钟先是跑到老掌柜那询问，随后回来道：“共计六百下品灵石，这已是我能争取到的最大折扣了。”
沈云点了点头，抱拳道：“多谢沈钟兄，这些我都要了。”
这个价格比想象中的还低不少，沈云爽快的付账，随后出言告辞。
content_en:
After leaving the lecture hall, Shen Qingruo asked curiously: "Where is Brother Shen Yun going?"
Chen Yun weighed the Qiankun bag and said casually: "Let's go to Fangshi. How about you?"
Now that the spirit stone is in hand, Shen Yun is ready to learn a spiritual art of cultivating immortals.
Shen Qingruo smiled and said, "I have nothing to do now, so why don't I go with you?"
Hearing this, Shen Yun felt weird. She had just rejected Shen Qiu a minute ago, but she didn't expect that she would change her mind faster than flipping through a book.
‘Speaking of which, except when we first met, Qing Ruo has never shown any expression to me.
Shen Yun sighed in his heart, apart from Shen's father, the person he had spent the longest time with in this life was Shen Qingruo, and he had unknowingly regarded her as his relative.
Shen Qingruo blinked her eyes and followed him quietly, thinking to herself: 'Brother Shen Yun has been mysterious lately, I want to see what he is doing.
The Shen family is located in the east of Canglang Mountain and has a vast territory.
Among the mountains, there is a huge open plain, and a majestic city sits on it.
There was a lot of traffic and people, and many caravans gathered at the city gate, waiting in line to enter the city.
“As expected of Shenjiafang City, there is an endless stream of tourists coming and going.”
"With the protection of the Shen family, no robbery cultivator dares to attack easily. It is worth spending more money."
"I heard that Fangshi has everything. I can't wait to go to the city."
“…”
As soon as Shen Yun entered the city, his eyes suddenly opened up.
The broad bluestone road extends to the horizon, with shops lined on both sides of the street, offering a full range of categories.
The spiritual food shop, the spiritual talisman shop, the elixir shop...it was dazzling to see. Walking through the splendid seven-story spiritual pavilion, two beautiful female cultivators were soliciting customers.
Shen Qingruo frowned and pulled Shen Yun away quickly with an expressionless expression.
Seeing their looks, the female cultivator covered her mouth and smiled and said, "It's good to be young."
Shen Qingruo only focused on moving forward, and Shen Yun said helplessly: "Stop, the Lingfu Tower has already passed."
Hearing this, Shen Qingruo stopped, looked back and hummed: "Dad used to like to go to Xianlefang. My mother taught me many times. Brother Shen Yun can't imitate him."
Chen Yun's mouth twitched, "Uncle An has thick eyebrows and big eyes, but he didn't expect that he likes to listen to music."
After sighing for a moment, Shen Yun quickly turned over the article and then walked towards the Lingfu Tower.
As soon as I entered the gate, I saw dozens of crystal counters filled with various types of talismans, a dazzling array.
The old shopkeeper is sitting in front of the counter, drinking tea with a plate of tea, as if the old god is there, and doesn't care whether the customer buys it or not. The main focus is on Buddhist style.
When Shen Yun was about to pick something, a thin clerk came towards him and greeted, "What does the customer need to buy?"
After seeing who was coming, Shen Yun hesitated and said, "Are you Shen Zhong?"
The clerk took a closer look and said happily: "It turns out to be Brother Yun. Why are you here at Lingfu Building today?"
Shen Yun smiled slightly, "I'm very interested in the Talisman Master and I'm going to buy some materials."
He and Shen Zhong had been neighbors for two years. After that, the other person's family fell into decline and he moved to the foot of the mountain. Unexpectedly, he met Shen Zhong here.
"Is Brother Shen Zhong an apprentice here?"
Shen Qingruo also knew Shen Zhong, so she asked.
Shen Zhong nodded and said with emotion: "I have been an apprentice here for two and a half years. If Brother Shen Yun wants to become a spiritual talisman master, he has asked the right person."
With his hands flying like flying, he took out jade slips, talisman paper, talisman pens, and talisman ink from the counter, and then introduced: "These are the tools needed to make talismans."
Chen Yun took the materials and said without hesitation: "How many spirit stones are there in total?"
He had learned about the market before. Although the profit of magical talismans was not as good as that of alchemy and weapon refining, fortunately, the sales volume was large, the production was fast, and the entry cost was low. It was the best choice for earning spiritual stones.
Shen Zhong first ran to the old shopkeeper to inquire, and then came back and said: "A total of six hundred low-grade spiritual stones. This is the biggest discount I can get."
Shen Yun nodded and cupped his fistsSaid: "Thank you very much, Brother Shen Zhong, I want all of these."
The price was much lower than expected. Shen Yun paid the bill readily and then said goodbye.
